answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run on bonded admission with beacon-anchored identity. Before joining the haven of attested peers, each agent locks a refundable deposit and binds it to one hardware-rooted beacon key. Verifiers then sample random tasks across the terrace of registered agents and compare execution fingerprints. Deposits of any correlated cluster are slashed together, so an operator spinning duplicate agents must stake fresh capital per identity while facing cascade forfeiture; every extra bot multiplies both the cost and the risk of total loss.
